CSB\t新西暦と呼ばれる時代。\n人類が宇宙へ本格的に進出してから約２世紀が経: The New Common Era: two centuries into humanity's move to space, yet daily life was much as it was in the early 21st century.
CSB\tそれは、旧西暦時代に地球へ落下した二つの隕石による被害と\n混乱のため: Damage and chaos from two meteorites that struck Earth in the old era had stalled progress for a time.
CSB\tそして、新西暦１７９年。\nアイドネウス島に第３の隕石「メテオ３」が落: In NCE 179, a third meteorite, Meteor 3, fell on Aidoneus Island.
CSB\tメテオ３の調査を行ったビアン・ゾルダーク博士は、\nそれが人工物であり: Dr. Bian Zoldark, who studied Meteor 3, was convinced it was artificial, dropped on Earth by someone's design.
CSB\tなぜならメテオ３は、Ｌ５宙域に突如出現した後、\n地球へ落下……しかも: Meteor 3 had suddenly appeared in the L5 sector, then fallen to Earth... and slowed before impact. Inside, materials and tech data unknown to humanity were sealed, plainly meant to be read.
CSB\tそれらはエクストラ・オーバー・テクノロジー……\n「ＥＯＴ」と呼称され: Dubbed Extra Over Technology, or EOT, they were studied further under strict secrecy by the EOT Special Council of top Earth Federation Government officials and the EOTI Institute headed by Bian.
CSB\tそして、何者か……すなわち地球外知的生命体が使用していると\n思われる: And when data was found on jointed mobile weapons over 10 meters tall, apparently used by that someone--intelligent aliens--Bian grew deeply wary of them.
CSB\tビアンは、地球外知的生命体がＥＯＴを\n人類へ提供した目的を推測し、そ: Bian surmised why the aliens had given EOT to humanity, and judged that their plan very likely included an invasion.
CSB\tまた、彼は地球外知的生命体…コードネーム「エアロゲイター」による\n侵: He warned the Federation of invasion by these aliens, code-named Aerogators. Alarmed, Major General Norman Slay proposed the Earth Sphere Defense Plan, launching development of Personal Troopers, humanoid weapons to fight them...
CSB\t新西暦１８６年。\n対戦型ロボットアクションゲーム「バーニングＰＴ」選: NCE 186. Ryusei Date was competing in the Burning PT robot fighting game championship when mysterious mobile weapons attacked the venue...
CSB\t地球圏防衛計画の一環で、地球連邦軍伊豆基地で進められていたＳＲＸ計画の: Major Ingram Plissken, central to the SRX Project at the Federation's Izu Base under the Earth Sphere Defense Plan, saw Ryusei's potential and drew him in. Like it or not, Ryusei became a Personal Trooper (PT) test pilot.
CSB\t地球連邦軍南極コーツランド基地において、最新鋭艦であるスペースノア級万: At the Federation's Coatsland Base in Antarctica, a ceremony was to unveil the Shirogane, first Space Noah-class battleship, and the EOTI Institute's Granzon. In truth, it was a disguised peace summit with the aliens known as the Guest...
CSB\tグランゾンの開発者の一人、シュウ・シラカワ博士は突如ゲスト側を攻撃、更: Granzon co-developer Dr. Shu Shirakawa suddenly attacked the Guest, then turned on the Federation, razing Coatsland Base. Then Bian Zoldark's EOTI Institute, calling itself the Divine Crusaders (DC), rose against the Earth Federation Government.
CSB\tＤＣとそれに策応したコロニー統合軍の決起により、世界は戦火に包まれた。: The DC and the allied United Colony Corps rose up, plunging the world into war. Blitzing with Armored Modules (AM), the DC seized bases across the Earth Sphere. Ryusei, reunited with Tenzan Nakajima in battle, recalled why he fights.
CSB\t連邦軍伊豆基地司令レイカー・ランドルフは戦況を打開すべく、ダイテツ・ミ: To turn the tide, Izu Base commander Laker Randolf ordered Commander Daitetsu Minase to hit DC HQ with the Hagane. As it readied to launch, a DC unit led by Rai's brother Elzam attacked...
CSB\t大型ミサイル飛来による絶体絶命的状況でリュウセイはＳＲＸ計画で開発され: Facing doom from a Large Missile, Ryusei activated the SRX Project's R-1, and the rescued Hagane set course for Aidoneus Island. Then Masaki Andoh, Cybuster's pilot who'd saved the SRX Team in Antarctica, appeared. Hunting Shu, he agreed to fight alongside the Hagane.
CSB\t一行はラングレー基地から脱出してきたジョナサンと合流。超闘士グルンガス: The group joined Jonathan, who'd fled Langley Base, received the super fighter Grungust, and learned former Instructor Sänger Sombold had joined the DC. Among the foes trying to stop the Hagane was Ryoto Hikawa. Realizing he'd been a captive pawn of the DC, he resolved to fight with the Hagane.
CSB\tハガネによるアイドネウス島ＤＣ要塞攻略作戦が開始された。しかし、トロニ: The Hagane began its assault on the DC's Aidoneus Island fortress. But the Tronium Buster Cannon's strike on its core failed, and Captain Daitetsu opted to send in the PTs.
CSB\t要塞中枢部で待ち受けていたヴァルシオンとグランゾンとの死闘。ビアンはマ: A deadly clash with Valsion and Granzon at the core. Bian fell, entrusting Earth to Masaki's group.
CSB\tアイドネウス島での決戦後、救難信号を受けたハガネは地中海に面する連邦特: After Aidoneus, the Hagane answered a distress call from the Principality of Rikusent, routing DC remnants and saving Princess Shine.
CSB\tシャイン王女を連れ、伊豆基地へ帰投したハガネ。そこでリュウセイ達ＳＲＸ: The Hagane returned to Izu Base with Princess Shine. There, the SRX Team faced a mock battle with the ATX Team, led by Kyosuke Nanbu, test pilot for the ATX Project to develop humanoid assault weapons...
CSB\t両チームは戦いを通して互いの実力を認め合った。同じ頃、Ｌ５宙域には異星: The fight earned each team the other's respect. Meanwhile, the Aerogators' huge fortress White Star appeared at L5. The Hiryu Custom, sent to watch, was attacked by small units. The threat Bian foretold had come true.
CSB\tＬ５宙域付近へ派遣されたハガネとヒリュウ改の前にビアンの娘、リューネが: Near L5, Bian's daughter Lüne met the Hagane and Hiryu Custom. She joined Masaki's group against the aliens, and Rai's cousin Leona quit the DC to aid the Federation. Aerogator leader Levi Torah demanded the Earth Federation Government's surrender.
CSB\t伊豆基地ではレイカー司令不在の隙を突かれ、シャイン王女が連れ去られてし: With Commander Laker away, Princess Shine was abducted from Izu Base. Adler Koch's DC remnants exploited the chaos of the Aerogators' arrival to seize Geneva. Former Instructor Tempest Hawker, sent to stall the Hagane, suffered a breakdown from the side effects of the Valsion Custom's Game System.
CSB\tハガネとヒリュウ改はジュネーブへ急行するが、彼らの前にテンザンと、精神: The Hagane and Hiryu Custom rushed to Geneva, but Tenzan and the mind-controlled Princess Shine in the Valsion Custom blocked them. They barely saved Shine and beat Tenzan. Sänger, missing since the DC War, helped dash Adler's plans.
CSB\tプラスパーツがロールアウトしたＲシリーズのテストを行うため、中国地区の: En route to a range in China to test the R Series with their new Plus Parts, the Hagane met a huge Aerogator force. Ingram ordered Ryusei's team to Combine into the SRX...
CSB\tハガネのクルー達は、共に戦ってきたイングラムがエアロゲイターのスパイで: The Hagane's crew was shocked that Ingram, their comrade-in-arms, was an Aerogator spy. Ryusei's SRX Team resolved to settle things with Ingram themselves.
CSB\t連邦軍統合参謀本部のノーマン・スレイ少将が立案したエアロゲイターの本拠: As Operation SRW, Major General Norman Slay's assault on the Aerogators' base White Star, drew near, Ingram appeared again. After a hard fight, Ryusei's team finally managed to Combine into the SRX.
CSB\tエアロゲイターは拉致した地球人に精神制御を加え、機動兵器のパイロットに: The Aerogators turned abducted humans into mind-controlled pilots. Dying, his memory restored, Galuin--former Instructor captain Kar-wai Lau--left Earth's future to his comrades.
CSB\tオペレーションＳＲＷを目前にしてＬ５宙域へ結集する連邦軍宇宙艦隊。つい: With Operation SRW at hand, Federation space fleets gathered at L5. At last, the decisive all-out attack on the Aerogators' White Star began. Overwhelmed and cornered, the Earth Federation Army fleet sent mobile units to storm White Star.
CSB\t危機的状況の中、ハガネの機転によって窮地を脱し、助勢に駆け付けたクロガ: The Hagane's quick thinking broke them out of a crisis, and joined by the Kurogane, they entered White Star. At its core, Ingram waited to give them a final trial. His mission: spread disinformation to bring Earth's forces under the Aerogators, and find gifted humans...
CSB\t中枢部を破壊してホワイトスターを脱出した一行の前に現れるエアロゲイター: Having destroyed the core and fled White Star, they faced Aerogator leader Levi Torah. After a deadly fight, they destroyed his Judecca, but that unsealed Meteor 3 on Aidoneus Island.
CSB\tメテオ３に隠されていた、エアロゲイターの最終兵器「セプタギン」。それは: Hidden in Meteor 3 was the Aerogators' ultimate weapon, Septuagint. It was programmed to activate should humanity become a threat to them...
CSB\t戦いは終わり、世界に再び平和が訪れた。\n共に戦った一同はそれぞれの道: The war ended; peace returned. The comrades-in-arms went their own ways...

<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A measure of a pilot's growth.</C></H></W>

　●Pilots level up as they gain EXP. Leveling up raises a pilot's stats, teaches

　●Damaging an enemy unit in battle earns EXP based on the enemy's level. Using

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>EXP earned from MAP weapon attacks is 1/3 of normal.

CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>４</W>．資金をより多く得るために: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>4</W>. How do I earn more funds?
CSB\tＡ．精神コマンド「幸運」、特殊スキル「強運」、エースパイロット、難易度: A. Use the Spirit Command Luck, the Special Skill Fortune, aces, difficulty, etc.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>There are the following methods.</C></H></W>

　●Use <LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as "Luck".

　●Use the <LINK=1>Special Skill</LINK> "Fortune".

　●Use ace pilots. A pilot who shoots down 50 or more enemies becomes an ace,
　　gaining +5 <LINK=2>Will</LINK> on deployment and 1.2x <LINK=3>funds</LINK> from kills.

　●Use the <LINK=4>difficulty</LINK>. If you've earned under 80% of <LINK=5>SR Points</LINK>, the
　　difficulty is NORMAL; at 80% or more, it's HARD. On NORMAL, you earn 1.2x
　　the funds you would on HARD.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>５</W>．経験値をより多く得るため: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>5</W>. How do I earn more EXP?

CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>There are the following methods.</C></H></W>

　●Use <LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as "Gain".

　●Use the <LINK=1>Special Skill</LINK> "EXP Up".

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>The higher the target pilot's level, the more <LINK=2>EXP</LINK> you earn.
CSB\tＡ．温存した戦力で、短期間で倒すようにします。: A. Save your strength and defeat it fast.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下のような点に注:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Keep the following points in mind.</C></H></W>

　●Save the forces and <LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> you'll need for the fight.

　●Raise <LINK=1>Will</LINK> to what your attack weapons require. If you can't raise it with
　　<LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> or <LINK=2>Special Skills</LINK>, defeat weaker enemies first.

　●If the enemy has barrier-type <LINK=3>Special Abilities</LINK>, <LINK=4>nullify the barrier</LINK>.

　●Weaken the unit and pilot with weapons that have <LINK=5>Special Effect 1</LINK> traits
　　such as "Armor Down L (R-type)".

　●Put into practice ways to <LINK=6>deal more damage</LINK>, <LINK=7>take less damage</LINK>,
　　<LINK=8>raise hit rate</LINK> and <LINK=9>raise evasion</LINK>.

　●Tough enemies yield high <LINK=10>funds</LINK> and <LINK=11>EXP</LINK>, so use <LINK=12>Spirit Commands</LINK>
　　and <LINK=13>Special Skills</LINK> to finish them off.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Units with the <LINK=14>Special Ability</LINK> "HP Recovery" regain 10-30% of max
　　　HP at the start of the enemy phase. An enemy with 100,000 max HP recovers
　　　10,000-30,000, so concentrate your attacks into as few turns as possible.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>２</W>．敵のバリアでダメージを与: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>2</W>. What if barriers block my damage?
CSB\tＡ．バリア発生条件を妨げたり、精神コマンド「直撃」、「特殊効果２」を持: A. Prevent barrier activation, or use Pierce or Special Effect 2 weapons.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>バリア系特殊能力を:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Barrier-type Special Abilities can be nullified as follows.</C></H></W>

　●If a barrier needs Will or EN to activate, lower the enemy's <LINK=0>Will</LINK> or drain
　　its EN with <LINK=1>Special Effect 1</LINK> weapons to stop it from activating.

　●The <LINK=2>Spirit Command</LINK> "Pierce" keeps barrier-type <LINK=3>Special Abilities</LINK>
　　from activating.

　●Attack with <LINK=4>Special Effect 2</LINK> weapons.
CSB\tＡ．２機で構成されている部隊のことです。: A. A unit made up of two machines.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>２機で構成されてい:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A unit made up of two machines.</C></H></W>

　●A unit consists of 1 or 2 machines. A two-machine unit is called a Twin Unit,
　　and a one-machine unit a Single Unit.

　●In the Intermission, arrange machines with the Unit Formation command to switch
　　between Twin Units and Single Units.

　●On the map, use the Join unit command to form a Twin Unit and Split to form
　　Single Units. To join, the units must touch in one of the 8 surrounding squares.

　●Battleships can't form Twin Units.

　●Twin Units have these advantages:
　・Both machines get the combined effects of the <LINK=0>Abilities</LINK> equipped on
　　both.
　・<LINK=1>Twin Spirit Commands</LINK> become available.
　・Total <LINK=2>EXP</LINK> and <LINK=3>PP</LINK> earned in battle increase.
　・Both machines can attack, so you can deal more damage in one battle.

　●If a Twin Unit splits on the map, any <LINK=1>Twin Spirit Command</LINK> effects it had
　　are lost. Effects of <LINK=4>Spirit Commands</LINK> that apply to the whole unit, like
　　"Accel", carry over only to the machine of the pilot who used them.
CSB\tＡ．移動タイプが似通った機体同士で部隊を編成します。: A. Pair machines with similar movement types.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>移動タイプが似通っ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Pair machines with similar movement types.</C></H></W>

　●A Twin Unit's <LINK=0>movement type</LINK> is set by those of its two machines. Each
　　type, Air (A), Land (L), Water (W) and Underground (U), shows in normal color if
　　both machines have it, or gray if only one does. Normal-color types cost less
　　to enter terrain than gray ones, so consider both machines' movement types.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><C=00C0FFFF><I=157></C></H></W></Y><S=3>If an [AL<C=808080FF>--</C>] machine pairs with a [<C=808080FF>-</C>L<C=808080FF>-</C>U] machine, the
　　　Twin Unit's movement type becomes [<C=808080FF>A</C>L<C=808080FF>-U</C>].

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>If "<C=808080FF>A</C>" is gray, the unit can't move into the air.
CSB\tＡ．自部隊に効果のある精神コマンドを、各部隊に振り分けます。: A. Spread self-targeted Spirit Commands across units.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>自部隊に効果のある:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Spread self-targeted Spirit Commands across units.</C></H></W>

　●<LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> that affect your own unit should be spread over as many
　　units as possible, without doubling up in one unit. Typical examples follow.

　<T=30>Accel</T>
　・Once, adds +3 to movement.

　<T=30>Awaken</T>
　・Grants one extra action.

　<T=30>Luck</T>
　・Doubles the funds earned in the next battle.

　<T=30>Gain</T>
　・Doubles the EXP earned in the next battle.
CSB\tＡ．部隊内の同じアビリティが３個になるように編成を行います。: A. Form units so they hold 3 of the same Ability.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>部隊内の同じアビリ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Form units so they hold 3 of the same Ability.</C></H></W>

　●In a Twin Unit, the 12 slots of both machines and their two main pilots
　　count, and both machines receive the <LINK=0>Ability effects</LINK>.
CSB\tＡ．装備している武器が似通った機体同士で部隊を編成します。: A. Pair machines with similar equipped weapons.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>装備している武器が:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Pair machines with similar equipped weapons.</C></H></W>

　●So the sub machine isn't left unable to attack due to lack of range, consider
　　each machine's max weapon range, post-move attacks and ALL attacks, and form
　　units so both machines can attack at the same times.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Machines that can swap weapons can adjust their loadout by equipping
　　　<LINK=0>Replace Weapons</LINK>.
CSB\tＡ．シナリオでの人間関係を考慮して編成を行います。: A. Factor in relationships from the story.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>シナリオでの人間関:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Factor in relationships from the story.</C></H></W>

　●Pilots with special story relationships who are near each other on the map
　　may have a positive effect in battle.

　●Friendship or trust, as between teammates or close friends, affects <LINK=0>hit rate</LINK>
　　and <LINK=1>evasion</LINK> in battle.

　●Romantic feelings affect the damage dealt in battle.

　●Rivals who acknowledge each other affect the critical hit rate in battle.
CSB\tＡ．パイロットが搭乗する機体を変更することです。: A. Changing the machine a pilot rides.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>パイロットが搭乗す:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Changing the machine a pilot rides.</C></H></W>

　●Pilots generally suit their starting machines, so transfers aren't often
　　needed. But transferring as the situation calls for, such as when you get a
　　new machine, or moving a pilot whose defeat is a loss condition into a
　　high-armor machine, can make the game easier. Use the Intermission's
　　Transfer command.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Some pilots can't be transferred, and some machines limit which
　　　pilots can board them.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>弱点を補い、長所を:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Cover weaknesses, boost strengths. Some examples:</C></H></W>

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><C=00C0FFFF><I=157></C></H></W></Y><S=3>Put high-Melee pilots in machines with strong melee weapons, and
　　　high-Ranged pilots in machines with strong ranged weapons.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><C=00C0FFFF><I=157></C></H></W></Y><S=3>Put pilots with the <LINK=0>Spirit Command</LINK> "Bullseye" in low-Aim machines.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><C=00C0FFFF><I=157></C></H></W></Y><S=3>Put pilots with the <LINK=1>Special Skill</LINK> "Continuous Attack" in machines
　　　with combination-capable weapons.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Some pilots' battle quotes change depending on their machine.
　　　Some lines can only be heard with specific combinations.

WTD\t③回避時、被命中率が<C=00FF00FF>50%</C>未満になる場: 3. Evade if enemy hit rate drops below <C=00FF00FF>50%</C>

CSB\tかつて、マサキが身を寄せていた神聖ラングラン王国は\n王都を襲った大規: Holy Langran, Masaki's onetime home, collapsed after a massive terror attack on its capital crippled its government.
CSB\t時を同じくしてシュテドニアス連合が侵攻……\nラングランは混乱の渦に巻: Meanwhile, the Schtedonias Union invaded... and Langran fell into chaos.
CSB\tテロ計画を裏で操っていたと思われたシュウを追って\n地上に出たマサキで: Masaki chased Shu, the suspected mastermind, to the surface. After Shu's death and many twists, he returned to Langran.
CSB\t現在のラングランはシュテドニアス軍、\nラングラン軍、独自の行動を取る: Now Langran is torn three ways: Schtedonias, the Langran Army, and Kirkus's rogue forces...
CSB\t地球圏への武力干渉を行った異星人インスペクター……\n地球連邦政府へ反: Alien Inspectors who attacked the Earth Sphere... Neo DC rebels against the Earth Federation Government... Shadow Mirror, their parallel-world allies... and the mysterious Einst.
CSB\tそれらの主力は、地球連邦軍の戦闘母艦ハガネ、\nヒリュウ改、そしてクロ: Their main forces fell to the Federation warships Hagane, Hiryu Custom and Kurogane.
CSB\t後に「インスペクター事件」と呼ばれることになる\n一連の争乱は終結し、: The conflict later known as the Inspector Incident was over, and peace was returning to Earth.
CSB\t地球連邦政府は、度重なる地球外知的生命体との戦闘を教訓とし、\n地球連: Learning from repeated clashes with alien life, the Federation chose to expand Project Aegis to reorganize and strengthen its forces.
CSB\tその一環として、量産型ヒュッケバインＭｋ‐Ⅱに次ぐ\n新たな量産主力機: As part of this, makers were asked to build a successor to the Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II, to be chosen by trial.
CSB\t別世界からの侵略者が絶えていないことを……\n彼らがインスペクター事件: that otherworldly invaders still lurked... active since the Inspector Incident's final days.
CSB\t新たな戦鐘は、今、打ち鳴らされようとしていた。: Now, the bells of a new war begin to toll.
CSB\tアースクレイドル警護の任についた、地球連邦軍第３特殊作戦ＰＴ部隊「クラ: The Federation's 3rd Special Ops PT Unit, the Cry Wolves, guards the Earth Cradle. On orders from Dr. Mitar Zapad, head of the Tsentr Project for autonomous, maintenance-free mass-production units, Captain Albero, his subordinate Hugo and his son Foglia capture the Einst Regisseur.
CSB\t同プロジェクトに所属するエリック・ワン博士の依頼により、クライウルブズ: Dr. Eric Wang of the same project sends the Cry Wolves to the White Star to recover the spatial transfer device from Shadow Mirror's super robot Zweizergain. Infiltrating its core, Hugo's team salvages the wrecked super robot they find and escapes...
CSB\t浅草に住む高校生、コウタ・アズマは突然現れた謎の敵の攻撃に巻き込まれ、: Asakusa high schooler Kota Azuma is caught in a mystery foe's sudden attack. To save his town and sister Shoko, Kota accepts Roa, the warrior from his dreams, and becomes Fighter Roar. Grandpa Kisaburo launches the Compatible Kaiser, left by Roa, to save Kota...
CSB\t時を同じくして現れた、自らを「修羅」と称する二機のアンノウン。彼等はコ: Meanwhile, two unknown units calling themselves Shura attack Kota. Aided by Kai's team, Kota sweeps the enemy from Asakusa. His grandfather Kisaburo reveals that Kota was chosen by Roa, a warrior from another world, to protect the world.
CSB\t晴海で行われていた地球連邦軍の新型主力機披露式典の最中、突如連邦軍の次: At Harumi's unveiling of the Federation's next mainstay, the Bartoll suddenly goes berserk. In the chaos, Shoko is abducted by the Shura Folka, and Kusuha, Lamia and others are taken by Bartolls.
CSB\t拉致した人間を機動兵器の生体コアとし、マスターコアでシステムを制御する: The ODE System uses abducted people as bio-cores for mobile weapons, controlled through a Master Core. To shut down Dr. Jurgen's system, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom attempt to storm his base, Hellgate. Rescuing Kusuha's group from the Bartolls, they push inside.
CSB\tヘルゲート内部へ突入したハガネとヒリュウ改の行く手に立ち塞がったのは、: Inside Hellgate, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom are blocked by Lamia, now a Bartoll bio-core. Her rescue seems a success, but Dr. Jurgen, his mind lost to the ODE System, strikes her down. After a fierce battle, they destroy the Master Core. But then a new, mysterious enemy appears...
CSB\t連邦軍艦隊によるヘルゲートへの核攻撃の時刻が迫る中、ハガネとヒリュウ改: As the Federation fleet's nuclear strike on Hellgate nears, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom must retreat...
CSB\tヘルゲート付近に出現した、巨大構造物「ソーディアン」を牙城とする修羅達: The Shura base themselves in Sordean, a colossal structure that appeared near Hellgate. Led by Shura King Alcaid, the mighty Shura Generals strike Earth's bases to seize the Earth Sphere. The Federation can find no way past Sordean's protective barrier.
CSB\t修羅の来襲に混乱する地球圏。元シャドウミラー隊のアクセル・アルマーは聞: The Earth Sphere reels from the Shura onslaught. Former Shadow Mirror member Axel Almer awakens to a familiar voice. He and his Soulgain had been moved to a Tsentr Project lab. Alone, questioning his reason to live, Axel hears a girl speaking into his mind.
CSB\tミタールによる実験の結果、アインストレジセイアはイェッツトレジセイアへ: Mitar's experiments turned the Einst Regisseur into the Jetzt Regisseur. The Jetzt goes out of control, and the Cry Wolves, sent to recapture it, are cornered. Axel boards the Soulgain and returns to the fray...
CSB\tイェッツトの殲滅を決意するアルベロ。奇しくも現れたシュウのグランゾンの: Albero vows to annihilate the Jetzt. With unexpected help from Shu's Granzon, they drive off the Jetzt. Resolved to see where a world of chaos and strife leads, Axel and Alchemie chase the fleeing Jetzt.
CSB\tショウコと接し、「力こそが全て」という修羅の在り方に疑念を抱くフォルカ: Through Shoko, Folka comes to doubt the Shura creed of might above all. Just before handing her to Duminas, he renounces the Shura name. Strategist Mizal sends Folka's fellow disciple Fernando after the traitor fleeing with Shoko...
CSB\tショウコを守り、フェルナンドと対峙するフォルカだったが、その隙を突かれ: Shielding Shoko, Folka faces Fernando, but in an unguarded moment she is taken again. Battle-worn, Folka is brought aboard the Kurogane. Meeting Shoko's brother Kota and their grandfather Kisaburo, he vows to rescue her.
CSB\tテスラ・ライヒ研究所に出現したアンノウンに反応するかのように、眠りにつ: As if sensing an unknown at the Tesla Reich Institute, the slumbering RyuOhKi and KoOhKi awaken. Dr. Eri Anzai of the LTR suspects the Yokijin, foes of the Chokijin of ancient China destroyed long ago, have returned. It is an omen of new turmoil.
CSB\tデュミナスはついに『鍵』の一つ、ショウコを手に入れた。ショウコを救うた: Duminas finally has Shoko, one of the Keys. As Kota's team fights for her, a mysterious black unit appears. It resonates with the Compatible Kaiser, glowing...
CSB\t謎の黒い機体、Ｇサンダーゲートのパイロットが妹ショウコだと知り、愕然と: Kota is stunned to learn the black unit G-Thundergate is piloted by his sister Shoko. Axel and Alchemie rescue Raul's cornered team. Duminas sends the repaired Lamia against Kyosuke's arriving reinforcements...
CSB\tキョウスケ達はアクセルの力を借り、ラミアの奪還に成功する。一方、Ｇサン: With Axel's help, Kyosuke's team gets Lamia back. Meanwhile, learning the G-Thundergate serves Duminas, Roa fears an encounter with his nemesis, Dark Brain.
CSB\tフォルカは、義兄であり修羅最強の将軍、閃光のアルティスと対決する。そこ: Folka faces sworn brother Altis the Flash, the mightiest Shura General. Then Shoko appears in the G-Thundergate as Fighter Emmy. Kota keeps pleading with Shoko...
CSB\tショウコはデュミナスの精神制御から解き放たれ、コンパチブルカイザーとＧ: Shoko is freed from Duminas's mind control, and the Compatible Kaiser and G-Thundergate combine into the G-Compatible Kaiser. With Shoko finally back, Kota routs Tis's group.
CSB\t研究所から逃亡したイェッツトレジセイアを殲滅するため、攻撃を仕掛けるク: The Cry Wolves move to destroy the escaped Jetzt Regisseur. But energized by the RBE rounds Mitar entrusted to them, the Jetzt kills Foglia as he shields his father Albero. Hugo is gravely wounded, and the Cry Wolves are wiped out.
CSB\t鹵獲した修羅の転移装置「ダガ－」を使い、ソーディアン攻略作戦「オペレー: Using a captured Shura Dagger transfer device, Operation Overgate is launched against Sordean. The Hagane and Hiryu Custom warp inside. Fighting Fernando, Folka awakens Ialdabaoth's divine form.
CSB\tソーディアン内部を突き進むハガネとヒリュウ改。それを阻止しようとする修: The Hagane and Hiryu Custom storm through Sordean against the Shura Generals and King Alcaid. Defeated, the Shura King entrusts his people's future to Folka.
CSB\t修羅を退けてソーディアンの中枢部「奥の院」へと突入したハガネとヒリュウ: Past the Shura, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom reach Sordean's Inner Sanctum, where Duminas tries to kill them. Dark Brain, Roa's nemesis and Duminas's creator, appears...
CSB\t知的生命体の根絶を目的とする闇黒の叡智にコウタ達は決戦を挑む。死闘の結: Kota's team takes on the dark wisdom, bent on wiping out all intelligent life. Dark Brain falls, and the threat seems gone...
CSB\tしかし、マサキの危惧は現実のものとなり、シュウ・シラカワはついにその牙: Masaki's fears come true: Shu Shirakawa finally bares his fangs. Masaki's team wins, and Shu, accepting his fate, vanishes between dimensions.
CSB\tついに戦いは終結した。\n様々な人々の想いが交錯する中、修羅王の後を継: At last, the war ends. Amid the hopes of many, Folka, the new Shura King, leaves with Sordean for new lands...

FIXH\t発動時、その戦闘での攻撃の命中率・回避率・クリティカル発生率を１００:
When triggered, hit, evasion and critical rates become 100% for that battle. Higher skill levels
raise the activation rate.
FIXH\tスキルレベルが高くなるほど、搭乗機体の残りＨＰ％に応じて命中率・回避:
Raises the unit's hit rate, evasion, armor and critical rate based on its remaining HP%.
Higher skill levels increase the effect.
FIXH\t発動時、敵からの攻撃前に反撃を行うことができます。スキルレベルが高く: Triggers a counterattack before the enemy attacks. Higher skill levels raise its rate.
FIXH\tスキルレベルが高くなるほど搭乗機体の移動力とマップ兵器以外の、格闘武: Higher skill levels raise the unit's Move and non-MAP melee weapon power.
FIXH\tスキルレベルが高くなるほど搭乗機体のマップ兵器以外の、射撃武器の攻撃: Higher skill levels raise the power and range of the unit's non-MAP ranged weapons.
FIXH\tスキルレベルが高くなるほど自機の指揮範囲内に存在する味方機体の命中率: Higher skill levels raise hit and evasion of allies in this unit's command range.
FIXH\tコンビネーション攻撃可能な武器で攻撃を行った場合に、コンビネーション:
Triggers a combination attack when attacking with a combination-capable weapon.
Continuous Attack Lv + 1 = number of units that can attack.
FIXH\t敵機体撃墜時の獲得資金が１．２倍になります。幸運などの効果と重複した:
Money from destroying enemy units is x1.2. Even when stacked with effects such as Luck,
the money gained is capped at 2x.
FIXH\t攻撃目標のメインパイロットより技量が２０以上高い場合、攻撃目標の反撃:
If this pilot's Skill is 20+ higher than the target's main pilot, it makes a support
attack for itself after the target's counterattack.
FIXH\t武器を使用するために必要なスキルとしてのみ使用: Used only as a skill required for weapons
FIXH\t気力が１２０以上で攻撃した敵ユニットを壊滅させた場合、行動終了せずも:
When attacking with 120+ Will and destroying the enemy, the unit can act again without ending
its turn. Once per unit per phase (switching main pilots via "Transform", etc. adds no uses).

CSB\t新西暦１８７年。\n連邦政府に翻したディバイン・クルセイダーズとの「Ｄ: New Century 187. Six months after the DC War with the rebel Divine Crusaders and the L5 Campaign with the alien Aerogators...
CSB\t大戦によって中枢部や要人を失った\n地球連邦政府は組織の再編を余儀なく: After losing its leadership in the war, the Earth Federation Government reorganized, and Colony Union head Bryan Midcrid became its President.
CSB\tそして、彼は連邦議会でＬ５戦役の情報を公開……。\n後に「東京宣言」と: He then revealed the L5 Campaign data to Congress. Known as the "Tokyo Declaration," it officially confirmed alien life and hinted at the threat to humanity.
CSB\tさらにミッドクリッド大統領は地球圏の一致団結を訴え、\n連邦軍の組織改: President Midcrid also urged Earth Sphere unity and announced the Aegis Plan to restructure and arm the military, mass-producing and upgrading humanoid weapons.
CSB\tだが、それらの陰でうごめく者達がいた。: Yet others lurked in the shadows.
CSB\tかつて、ビアン・ゾルダーク博士が率いた軍事結社\n「ディバイン・クルセ: Remnants of the Divine Crusaders, or "DC," once led by Dr. Bian Zoldark... those plotting military rule within the Federation... the "shadow" linking them... and the mysterious "Einst Series"...
CSB\t地球人類は今、さらなる混迷の渦へ陥ろうとしていた……。: Humanity was about to sink into deeper chaos...
CSB\tテスラ・ライヒ研究所へと向かう一機の輸送機。その機体には時粒子を動力源: A transport heads for the Tesla Reich Institute carrying the Exxelant, powered by a Time Flow Engine running on time particles, and its test team, siblings Raul and Fiona. But a mystery unit appears near the institute, and Axel Almer of the Soulgain demands the Exxelant...
CSB\t突然現れたアンノウンと共に、ラウル達は何処かへと姿を消した。テスラ・ラ: Raul's group vanishes with a sudden Unknown. Axel rejoins the mysterious unit holding the Tesla Reich Institute for a transfer, but...
CSB\t地球連邦軍北米方面軍ラングレー基地に所属するＡＴＸチームは、ＤＣ残党の: The Earth Federation Army's ATX Team at Langley is hunting DC remnants. Joining Kyosuke's team is Lamia Loveless in the mysterious super robot Angelg.
CSB\tハワイのヒッカム基地で行われていた特殊戦技教導隊による、試作ＰＴのテス: At Hickam Base in Hawaii, DC remnants assault the Tactical Instructor Unit's prototype PT test. Seolla Schweizer, one of them, and Latune's old friend from The School, steals the ATX Project's new Bildfalken.
CSB\tＤＣ残党を追撃するため中国山東地区へ向かうハガネ。遺跡、蚩尤塚で「百邪: Chasing DC remnants, the Hagane heads to Shandong, China, where they attack LTR's Dr. Anzai at Chiyou Mound as she digs up Choukijin, bio-weapons the ancients built against demons called the Hundred Evils. An Unknown warps in.
CSB\tアースクレイドルを拠点として活動を活発化させるＤＣ残党。ハガネはＤＣ残: The DC remnants grow active from Earth Cradle, and the Hagane gives chase. Latune meets Arado Balanga, an old friend from The School, in the enemy force. Shot down shielding Seolla, Arado is captured.
CSB\t連邦軍のアースクレイドル攻略作戦「キルモール作戦」を察知したＤＣ残党は: Detecting Operation Kill Mole, the Federation's attack on Earth Cradle, the DC remnants hit the Hagane to stall it. The Unknown returns mid-battle, and Kyosuke hears a girl calling herself "Einst."
CSB\tＤＣ残党によるアフリカ北部制圧作戦「デザートクロス作戦」により、連邦軍: The DC remnants' Operation Desert Cross seizes northern Africa, foiling the Federation's Kill Mole. Van Vat Tran, leader of the remnants, declares the Neue DC's birth.
CSB\t連邦軍機失踪事件の調査のため、Ｌ２宙域へ向かったヒリュウ改は謎の機動兵: Probing missing Federation units, the Hiryu Custom meets mystery mobile weapons in L2. Alarmed, the government and brass issue Case E. En route to guard the White Star at L5, it stops at Mao Industries on the moon, where a mystery force strikes. Arado's heroics save the day and repel the enemy.
CSB\t連邦の主要拠点の一つ、アビアノ基地攻略の橋頭堡とするためリクセント公国: The Neue DC invades the Principality of Riksent to stage an attack on Aviano Base. Guarding escaped Princess Shine, Rai meets his nemesis Archibald Grims.
CSB\tホワイトスターを襲撃、占拠した謎の敵は「インスペクター」と名乗る異星人: The enemy that stormed the White Star is an alien race called the Inspectors. With spatial-transfer tactics, they start taking Earth's key bases. At Mao Industries, hit again, a transport with new PTs tries to flee. To save his cornered friends, Ryoto activates the Huckebein Mk-III...
CSB\tリョウトの機転によって月からの脱出に成功したものの、インスペクターによ: Ryoto's quick thinking gets them off the moon, but the Inspectors seize Mao Industries and Moon Cradle. Meanwhile, they also strike the Tesla Reich Institute, where Filio Presty leads Project TD, an interstellar travel program. The institute falls to the enemy along with its staff, including director Jonathan.
CSB\tプロジェクトＴＤの試作機と共に研究所を脱出したアイビス達。αプロトのパ: Ibis's group escapes the institute with Project TD's prototype. Stung to learn she wasn't chosen for the Alpha Proto, Sleigh leaves the group. Meanwhile, Seolla appears before Arado, her memory altered by Dr. Aguila Setome to see him as an enemy.
CSB\tノイエＤＣの南欧方面侵攻の橋頭堡となっているリクセント公国奪還のために: To retake the Principality of Riksent, the Neue DC's beachhead into southern Europe, the Hagane hits its garrison as a Shirogane-led force creates a diversion. With help from Latune and Shine's new AM Fairlion, they retake it, but Captain Lee Linjun's blunder gets the Shirogane captured.
CSB\tインスペクターへの反攻作戦「オペレーション・プランタジネット」。作戦参: Operation Plantagenet, the counterattack on the Inspectors. En route to Izu Base to join it, the Hiryu Custom is blocked by Wodan. Rescuing them is Sänger, missing since the L5 Campaign. Bullet and Kusuha head to Chiyou Mound to probe the Einst. Struggling against a new foe, they see the Choukijin appear...
CSB\tクスハとブリットの力、そしてグルンガスト参式を取り込むことで超機人は覚: Absorbing Kusuha and Bullet's power and the Grungust Type 3, the Choukijin awakens as RyuKoOh. Axel appears before Kyosuke and calls the Alteisen "Gespenst Mk-III." Targeted by Axel, Kyosuke is bewildered.
CSB\t連邦軍伊豆基地では、異星人に対して徹底抗戦を唱えるグライエン・グラスマ: At the Federation's Izu Base, Gryen Grassman's faction, calling for all-out war on aliens, stages the coup "Mission Harper," detaining Commander Laker. In the chaos, Vindel Mauser's special task force Shadow Mirror appears, and Lamia's secret mission and identity come to light...
CSB\tラミアはレモン・ブロウニングによって開発された「Ｗシリーズ」と呼ばれる: Lamia is an artificial human of the "W Series," created by Lemon Browning. Meanwhile, Mai, who had lost her memories, learns she was once the Aerogators' leader, Levi Torah. In battle, Mai and Aya are shocked to learn the truth of their birth, but accepting their past deepens their bond.
CSB\tレモンによって回収されたラミアは、シャドウミラーとの決別を決意する。ラ: Recovered by Lemon, Lamia resolves to break from Shadow Mirror. Lamia and Gilliam reveal Shadow Mirror came here after losing to the Beowulves, a Federation special unit on a parallel Earth, and that Gilliam, also a traveler, is System XN's core and vital to a sure dimensional jump.
CSB\tインスペクターに占拠されたテスラ・ライヒ研究所。その奪還に先行したゼン: Sänger's team leads the push to retake the Inspector-held Tesla Reich Institute, but Vigagi blocks them. The masked man Wodan saves the cornered Sänger. Filio's group barely boots Double G Unit 1, a humanoid weapon beneath the institute, but...
CSB\tテスラ研奪還に成功し、アイビス達はフィリオ等と再会を果たす。オペレーシ: After retaking the institute, Ibis's group reunites with Filio. As Operation Plantagenet nears its end, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom join Van Vat Tran's Neue DC in a raid on Langley Base. But Shadow Mirror, now allied with the Inspectors, ambushes and cripples the Hagane...
CSB\tアインストの出現による混乱に乗じて、一行は辛くも脱出に成功するが、キョ: Amid the Einst chaos, the group narrowly escapes, but Kyosuke is badly hurt and Captain Daitetsu dies.
CSB\t謎の声に呼ばれて艦を飛び出したエクセレンはその消息を絶ってしまう。エク: Called by a mysterious voice, Excellen leaves the ship and vanishes. Tracking her, Arado's group runs into Seolla. Fighting the Machinery Children created by Dr. Egret Fehu, Seolla regains her memories and resolves to join Arado.
CSB\t時流エンジンの暴走により「向こう側」から「こちら側」へ転移してきたラウ: Thrown from "over there" to "over here" by a runaway Time Flow Engine, Raul's group meets Axel, Fiona's sworn enemy. Saved by Gilliam and Lamia, they travel with Gilliam.
CSB\t各勢力の軍事拠点への無差別攻撃を開始するアインスト。その混戦状態を利用: The Einst begin indiscriminate attacks on all factions' bases. Amid the melee, the assault on Earth Cradle begins. Sänger faces Wodan, guardian of the Gate of Magus. The Kurogane storms Earth Cradle, where Lezner and Rai defeat their nemesis Archibald. Latune's desperate pleas restore Ouka's memories, but...
CSB\tウォーダンに後を託されたゼンガーは、イーグレット・フェフ博士が作り出し: Carrying on for Wodan, Sänger destroys Magus, which controls the Machine Cells, self-repairing, self-evolving metal cells made by Dr. Egret Fehu, and saves Dr. Sophia Nate, its core.
CSB\tインスペクターの生産拠点となっているムーンクレイドルを目指すヒリュウ改: The Hiryu Custom heads for Moon Cradle, the Inspectors' production base. A transformed Excellen blocks its path. Kyosuke sorties in his new Alteisen Riese, but his voice can't reach her and she leaves. With Shu's help, the Neue DC and the Hiryu Custom jointly retake Moon Cradle.
CSB\tホワイトスターへの攻撃のため合流するクロガネとヒリュウ改。そんな一行の: The Kurogane and Hiryu Custom unite to attack the White Star, but Excellen appears again. In the crisis, Kyosuke's all-or-nothing appeal restores her sanity.
CSB\tアインストの攻撃が続く中、ホワイトスターへの奇襲作戦を敢行するクロガネ: As the Einst attacks continue, the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom raid the White Star. When Kyosuke strikes, Echidna willingly takes the blow for Axel.
CSB\tホワイトスター内部へと突入したクロガネとヒリュウ改。キョウスケは激闘の: Inside the White Star, Kyosuke defeats Axel after a fierce battle, and Inspector commander Wendolo appears. Having audited Earth, the Inspectors judged that humanity's insatiable resolve for battle would disrupt galactic order, so they seek to rule the Earth Sphere.
CSB\tキョウスケ達はウェンドロを倒すことに成功したものの、アインストが展開し: Kyosuke and the others defeat Wendolo, but an energy field deployed by the Einst traps the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom inside the White Star. Shadow Mirror tries to seize Gilliam for a dimensional jump. The group beats Vindel, but...
CSB\tシステムＸＮによってアインスト空間と現世は繋がり、宇宙の侵蝕が開始され: System XN joins the Einst's realm to ours, and space begins eroding. Watchers of life since ancient times, the Einst seek to wipe out ever-warring humanity, which disturbs the cosmos, and create new life. Their leader, Neu Regisseur, merges with the White Star into Stern Neu Regisseur. The final battle begins.
CSB\tシュテルン・ノイレジセイアの消滅後、各地で活動していたアインストシリー: With Stern Neu Regisseur gone, the Einst Series active around the world halt and vanish. The war ends, and peace returns.

CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>機体専用のオプショ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Attaching and removing a unit's own option parts.</C></H></W>

　●Some units have their own replacement parts. Equipping or changing them
　　alters stats such as Mobility and Armor. Equipping them often brings
　　benefits such as extra powerful weapons. Replace parts with the
　　"Replace Parts" command in the Intermission.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>機体の武装の変更を:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Changing a unit's armaments.</C></H></W>

　●There are fixed weapons exclusive to each unit, and replaceable weapons that
　　can be freely equipped, removed and shared between units. Each replaceable
　　weapon has a Weapon Gauge cost, and a unit can change weapons freely as
　　long as the total stays within its Weapon Gauge capacity. Replace weapons
　　with the "Replace Weapons" command in the Intermission.

CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>パイロットの能力上:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Raising pilot stats and learning special skills.</C></H></W>

　●By spending <LINK=0>PP</LINK> (Pilot Points) earned in battle, you can raise a pilot's
　　stats or have them learn available <LINK=1>Special Skills</LINK>. Train pilots with
　　the "Pilot Training" command in the Intermission.

　●Pilots can learn special skills in up to 6 slots. A slot that already holds
　　a skill can be overwritten if you decide it isn't needed. However, skills
　　that would have no effect can't be learned.

　●Some special skills can be learned, while others are unique to certain
　　pilots and can't be learned. Unlearnable skills can't be overwritten with
　　other skills.

CSB\tＡ．機体の能力上昇や武器の攻撃力上昇を行うことです。: A. Raising unit stats and weapon attack power.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>機体の能力上昇や武:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Raising unit stats and weapon attack power.</C></H></W>

　●By spending <LINK=0>funds</LINK> earned in battle, you can raise a unit's HP, EN, Armor,
　　Mobility and Aim, and its weapons' attack power. Replaceable weapons must be
　　upgraded one by one, but a unit's fixed weapons are all upgraded together.
　　Upgrade with the "Upgrade" command in the Intermission.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>長所を伸ばすように:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Build on strengths.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>『HP』</T>
　・Suits units with high Armor and low Mobility. Units that can reliably dodge
　　enemy attacks don't take damage, so upgrading it does little for them.

　<T=30>『EN』</T>
　・Suits units equipped with weapons that consume a lot of EN.

　<T=30>『Armor』</T>
　・Suits units with high Armor and low Mobility. Units that can dodge enemy
　　attacks don't take damage, so upgrading it does little for them.

　<T=30>『Mobility』</T>
　・Suits units with high Mobility and low Armor. Units with enough Armor and
　　HP to withstand enemy attacks don't need to dodge, so upgrading it does
　　little for them.

　<T=30>『Aim』</T>
　・Suits units that can't make up for accuracy with spirit commands and such.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Upgrade HP, EN, Armor, Mobility and Aim all 10 levels, and...
CSB\tＡ．状況に応じて、固定武器と換装武器の改造を行います。: A. Upgrade fixed or replaceable weapons as needed.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>状況に応じて、固定:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Upgrade fixed or replaceable weapons as needed.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>『Fixed Weapons』</T>
　・All of a unit's weapons are upgraded at once, so it's costly, but they include
　　high-power weapons and can deal more damage than replaceable ones. To reliably
　　shoot down <LINK=0>tough enemies</LINK>, upgrade your main units' fixed weapons.

　<T=30>『Replaceable Weapons』</T>
　・Weaker than fixed weapons and poor against strong foes, but unlike fixed
　　weapons they can be removed from units that leave the story or that you no
　　longer use and kept in use on other units, so less money goes to waste.
CSB\tＡ．機体の能力を引き上げることができる装備のことです。: A. Equipment that boosts a unit's capabilities.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>機体の能力を引き上:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Equipment that boosts a unit's capabilities.</C></H></W>

　●Each unit can equip 1 to 4 Enhance Parts. Change equipped parts with the
　　"Equip Parts" command in the Intermission. Enhance Parts come in these
　　types:

　<T=30>『Unit』</T>
　・When equipped, raises unit stats such as <LINK=0>Move</LINK> and Mobility.

　<T=30>『Weapon』</T>
　・When equipped, raises weapon stats such as hit bonus and range.

　<T=30>『Consumable』</T>
　・When equipped, can be used with the unit's "Parts" command on the map to
　　restore HP, EN and so on. Usable once per map. Battleships alone can use
　　consumable parts on units within 3 squares.

　<T=30>『Special』</T>
　・When equipped, gives effects such as boosting several types at once, or
　　raising a pilot's <LINK=1>Will</LINK> at the start of a stage.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Unneeded parts can be sold for <LINK=2>funds</LINK>. Sell parts with the
　　　"Sell Parts" command in the Intermission.

CSB\tＳＲポイント・難易度についてのＱ＆Ａです。: Q&A about SR Points and difficulty.
CSB\tＡ．ゲームの難易度の元になる数値です。: A. The basis for game difficulty.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ゲームの難易度の元:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The basis for game difficulty.</C></H></W>

　●Meeting a stage's SR Point (Super Robot Wars Point) condition earns you
　　+1 SR Point.

　●Earning an SR Point gives +10 <LINK=0>PP</LINK> to all allied pilots on the map.


　●Check SR Point conditions with the "Objectives" command. Your SR Point rate
　　determines the next stage's <LINK=1>difficulty</LINK>.

　●Generally, with under 80% of SR Points earned the difficulty is NORMAL;
　　at 80% or more, it's HARD.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>If you replay a stage right after a Game Over, you can't earn that
　　　stage's SR Point.
CSB\tＡ．ＳＲポイントによって決まる、ゲームの難しさや易しさのランクです。: A. The game's difficulty rank, set by SR Points.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ＳＲポイントによっ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The game's difficulty rank, set by SR Points.</C></H></W>

　●Difficulty changes with your <LINK=0>SR Point</LINK> rate and has two ranks, HARD and
　　NORMAL. The current difficulty is shown in the general command menu.

　<T=30>『HARD (80% or more)』</T>　
　・Compared to NORMAL, there may be more enemies or stronger ones.
　・Enemy units and weapons get +3 to their <LINK=1>upgrade levels</LINK>.

　<T=30>『NORMAL (under 80%)』</T>
　・<LINK=2>Funds</LINK> earned in battle are 1.2x those on HARD.
CSB\t知っていると役に立つことについてのＱ＆Ａです。: Q&A about handy things to know.
CSB\tＡ．ゲームオーバー後、続けて再プレイします。: A. Retry right after a Game Over.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ゲームオーバー後、:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Retry right after a Game Over.</C></H></W>

　●After a Game Over, you return to the Intermission screen (except on Stage 1).
　　Choose the "Next Map" command in the Intermission to replay the same stage.
　　You can no longer earn its <LINK=0>SR Point</LINK>, but you keep your <LINK=1>funds</LINK>, pilot
　　<LINK=2>EXP</LINK> and kill counts. By repeating Game Overs, you can retry after building
　　up, such as <LINK=3>upgrading</LINK> units or leveling pilots. However, this doesn't
　　apply to newly debuting pilots or pilots exclusive to that scenario.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>You can lower the game's <LINK=4>difficulty</LINK> by deliberately not earning
　　　<LINK=0>SR Points</LINK>.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ショートカットボタ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use the shortcut buttons.</C></H></W>

　●While the move range is shown, press <S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=122></H></W></Y><S=-4> to jump the cursor to the
　　edge of the move range.

　●When choosing a destination, hold <S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=122></H></W></Y><S=-4> and press <S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=115></H></W></Y><S=-4> to skip the
　　move animation.
CSB\tＡ．ソフトリセット機能を使用します。: A. Use the soft reset function.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ソフトリセット機能:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use the soft reset function.</C></H></W>

　●Press <Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=125></H></W></Y><S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=126></H></W></Y><S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=121></H></W></Y><S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=122></H></W></Y><S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=123></H></W></Y><S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=124></H></W></Y><S=-4> at the same time to soft reset.

　●If you keep holding <S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=126></H></W></Y><S=-4> while soft resetting, the title screen is
　　skipped and the title's CONTINUE command runs automatically. This is

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Choosing CONTINUE on the title screen returns you to the state saved

CSB\tＡ．クリアデータを使用すると、特典を得ることができます。: A. Using clear data grants you bonuses.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>クリアデータを使用:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Using clear data grants you bonuses.</C></H></W>

　●After clearing the final stage, you can save your progress as clear data.
　　Loading clear data lets you start over from the beginning, carrying over

CSB\t新西暦と呼ばれる時代。\n\n異星人や並行世界からの来訪者達との戦いが: The New Century era. Some time after the wars with aliens and parallel-world visitors ended... Aidoneus Island, off the Marquesas in the South Pacific--where the alien Aerogators' Meteor 3 fell, and base of the militant Divine Crusaders (DC), who sparked civil war in the Earth Sphere--lay in sealed waters, long absent from history's stage.
CSB\t\nだが、その裏ではある計画が着々と進められていた。\n\nそれは、地: Behind the scenes, a plan advanced: a special ops unit, codename GS, obeying the Earth Federation Government's President, using ISA tactics (blitzkrieg by carrier battleships and their humanoid mobile weapons). Independent of the Earth Federation Army, it executes the President's special military orders. Under two presidential aides, Aidoneus Island was refortified, gathering many projects' fruits and new weapons. GS's true nature was hidden; officially, it was a weapons test unit. Can GS be a new sword guarding the Earth Sphere? Powers and schemes shake space-time... opening a gate to another world...

Pronounced "Kanan"; full name Kanan Jun. A hermit
of Baral. Gentle in manner but proud. Masculine in
both looks and bearing, she hides a fierce passion.
She doesn't scorn humans; rather, she feels a sort
of duty to show the right path to her much younger
siblings, who still don't grasp the order of things.
　Before shikai (shedding the flesh to become a
hermit), she was a beauty who dressed as a man.

A hermit of Baral who basically affirms everything
with "Good, good," having realized that resisting or
obeying, living or dying, is all equally futile.
Kanan's mentor, he answers her every word and deed
with "Good, good," treating her as his own daughter.

followed him as a master ever since. Baral's scout,
Hou summons and controls Yokijin using Kijin
Shoseifu talismans. Cool and gentle in manner.

FIXH\t特別な攻撃方法を使用せず、通常の攻撃を行います。: Make a normal attack with no special method.
FIXH\t目標ユニットと隣接する複数のユニットに対し、同時に攻撃を行います。: Attack the target and its adjacent units at the same time.
FIXH\t隣接する２つのユニットに対し、同時に攻撃を行います。: Attack two adjacent units at the same time.
FIXH\t移動範囲内の別の場所へ移動します。移動後には更に、別のコマンドを使用: Move elsewhere within range. Other commands may be usable after moving.
FIXH\t武器を選択し、射程内の敵に対して攻撃を行います。: Choose a weapon and attack an enemy in range.
FIXH\t戦艦に搭載されている部隊を再出撃させます。戦艦の行動終了後も実行可能: Redeploy units aboard the ship. Can be done after the ship has acted.
FIXH\t地上に移動します。地上に位置する場合、地形による防御、回避率補正を受: Move to the ground. Grounded units get terrain defense and evasion bonuses.
FIXH\t空中に移動します。空中に位置する場合、地形による防御、回避率補正を受: Take to the air. Airborne units get no terrain defense or evasion bonuses.
FIXH\t地中に移動します。地中に位置する場合、攻撃を受けなくなりますが、攻撃: Move underground. Units underground can't be attacked, but can't attack either.
FIXH\t水中に移動します。水中に位置する場合、地形による防御、回避率補正を受: Move underwater. Submerged units get terrain defense and evasion bonuses.
FIXH\t機体を別形態に変形させます。変形後は機体性能などが変化します。: Transform the unit into another form, changing its stats.
FIXH\t換装パーツを外し、別形態へ変形させます。変形後は機体性能などが変化し: Remove Replace parts and Transform into another form, changing stats.
FIXH\t装備している消費型の強化パーツを使用します（戦艦は３マス以内のユニッ: Use an equipped consumable part (ships may also use on units within 3 squares).
FIXH\t射程内に位置する部隊のＨＰを回復させます。回復量はパイロットのＬｖに: Restore HP of a squad in range. Amount rises with the Pilot's Lv.
FIXH\t射程内に位置する機体のＥＮ・弾数値を全回復させます。対象の機体は気力: Fully restore EN and ammo of a unit in range. Target unit loses 10 Will.
FIXH\tツインユニットのメイン側の機体を変更します。: Change the Twin Unit's main unit.
FIXH\t精神コマンド・ツイン精神コマンドを使用します。: Use Spirit and Twin Spirit Commands.
FIXH\tユニット能力、パイロット能力、機体能力、武器性能を確認することができ: View unit, Pilot, and mech stats, plus weapon data.
FIXH\t戦艦に搭載します。搭載中は自軍フェイズ開始時にＨＰ・ＥＮが１５％、弾: Board a ship. Aboard, HP/EN recover 15% and ammo fully at player phase start.
FIXH\t２機の機体を同じマスに配置して、ツインユニットにします。: Place two units on one square to form a Twin Unit.
FIXH\tツインユニットを２機の機体に分散させます。: Split a Twin Unit into two units.
FIXH\t隣接する敵を説得します。説得の結果、ストーリー展開が変化することもあ: Persuade an adjacent enemy. The outcome may change the story.
FIXH\t隣接するユニットを搭載し行動を終了します。移動後にも使用可能です。: Load an adjacent unit and end turn. Usable after moving.
FIXH\t目標を選択して、攻撃が命中するか、与えるダメージ等の設定を行います。: Select a target and set hit/miss, damage dealt, and so on.

CSB\t戦闘を有利に進めるためのコツを紹介します。: Tips for gaining the edge in battle.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ユニット（機体）の:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A unit's movement range.</C></H></W>

　●Use a unit's Move command to move it from its current position
　　to another.

　●Each map square has a cost (1-2.5) to enter. Each square moved
　　deducts its cost from Movement, and a unit can keep moving until
　　its Movement reaches 0.

　●Costs vary by terrain and the unit's movement type. The better
　　suited the <LINK=0>movement type</LINK> is to the terrain, the lower the cost.

　●A Twin Unit's Movement is the average of its 2 units' (rounded
　　down). Exception: moving through the air or underground always
　　costs 1 per square.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Moving through the air uses 1 EN per square. Units underground
　　　can't take part in battle.
CSB\tＡ．ユニット（機体）が移動可能な地形を表します。: A. The terrain a unit can move across.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ユニット（機体）が:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The terrain a unit can move across.</C></H></W>

　●Shows whether a unit or squad can move in Air, Land, Water and
　　Underground. Terrain it lacks the ability for is hard or impossible
　　to enter.

　●A unit that can move everywhere shows ALWU as its movement type;
　　each missing ability shows <C=808080FF>－</C> instead.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><C=00C0FFFF><I=157></C></H></W></Y><S=3>A unit without Air and Underground shows <C=808080FF>－</C>LW<C=808080FF>－</C>.

　●A <LINK=0>Twin Unit</LINK>'s movement type depends on its 2 units' types. Each
　　letter is ranked by being shown in normal color or gray. Normal color
　　means a lower cost to enter that terrain. If A (Air) is gray, however,
　　the squad can't move through the air.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Changing movement type with Parts and the like lowers terrain costs,
　　　extending how far a unit can move.
CSB\tＡ．精神コマンド、強化パーツ、特殊能力、アビリティ効果などを利用します: A. Use Spirit Commands, Parts, Special Abilities, Ability Effects.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can do the following.</C></H></W>

　●Use <LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as Accel.

　●Equip Movement-boosting <LINK=1>Parts</LINK> such as a Booster.

　●Equip movement type-changing <LINK=1>Parts</LINK> such as a Tesla Drive.

　●Use <LINK=2>Special Abilities</LINK> such as Transform.

　●Use the <LINK=3>Ability Effect</LINK> Movement↑.
CSB\tＡ．攻撃が命中した場合、攻撃力に応じて目標のＨＰが減少します。: A. A hit lowers the target's HP based on attack power.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃が命中した場合:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A hit lowers the target's HP based on attack power.</C></H></W>

　●In combat, units damage targets with their equipped weapons.
　　Higher attack power means more damage, but a miss deals none.
　　Attack using a unit's Attack command.

　●A unit whose HP (Hit Points) drops to 0 is shot down and removed
　　from the map. Shooting down enemies earns <LINK=0>EXP</LINK>, <LINK=1>funds</LINK> and more.
　　If a player unit is shot down, repair costs are deducted from your
　　funds at the end of the stage.

　●When attacked, a unit can <LINK=2>counter</LINK> if conditions are met.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>In most stages, you must shoot down enemies to meet the
　　　victory conditions.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>２</W>．敵からの攻撃に対して何が: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>2</W>. What can I do when attacked?
CSB\tＡ．攻撃を受けた場合、反撃、防御、回避を選択することができます。: A. When attacked, choose Counter, Defend or Evade.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃を受けた場合、:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>When attacked, choose Counter, Defend or Evade.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>[Counter]</T>
　・Counterattack with an equipped, usable weapon.

　<T=30>[Defend]</T>
　・Halves the damage taken.

　<T=30>[Evade]</T>
　・Halves the enemy's <LINK=0>hit rate</LINK>.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3><LINK=1>Map Weapons</LINK>, <LINK=2>Double Attacks</LINK>, <LINK=3>Combination Attacks</LINK>,
　　　<LINK=4>Maximum Breaks</LINK> and the like can't be used to counter.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>３</W>．敵へのダメージを増やすた: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>3</W>. How do I deal more damage?
CSB\tＡ．武器の改造、パイロット養成、気力、精神コマンド、アビリティ効果など: A. Use weapon upgrades, pilot training, Will, Spirit Commands, Ability Effects.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can do the following.</C></H></W>

　●<LINK=0>Upgrade weapons</LINK>.

　●Raise Melee, Ranged and more via <LINK=1>Pilot Training</LINK>.

　●Raise the attacking pilot's <LINK=2>Will</LINK>.

　●Lower the target pilot's <LINK=2>Will</LINK>.

　●Use <LINK=3>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as Valor.

　●Use <LINK=4>Ability Effects</LINK> such as Melee↑ and Ranged↑.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Attacks from a main unit on a sub unit, or from a sub on a main,
　　　deal only 65% of the damage of main-vs-main or sub-vs-sub
　　　combat.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>４</W>．敵からのダメージを減らす: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>4</W>. How do I take less damage?
CSB\tＡ．機体の改造、パイロット養成、気力、精神コマンド、強化パーツ、アビリ: A. Use unit upgrades, pilot training, Will, Spirit Commands, Parts, Ability Effects.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can do the following.</C></H></W>

　●Upgrade Armor via <LINK=0>Unit Upgrades</LINK>.

　●Raise Defense and more via <LINK=1>Pilot Training</LINK>.

　●Lower the attacking pilot's <LINK=2>Will</LINK>.

　●Raise the target pilot's <LINK=2>Will</LINK>.

　●Use <LINK=3>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as Wall.

　●Equip <LINK=4>Parts</LINK> such as Chobham Armor.

　●Use <LINK=5>Ability Effects</LINK> such as Armor↑.
CSB\tＡ．攻撃が目標に命中するかを判定するための確率です。: A. The chance that an attack hits its target.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃が目標に命中す:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The chance that an attack hits its target.</C></H></W>

　●Just before combat, the hit rate against each target is shown as
　　a percentage.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=154></H></W></Y><S=3><LINK=0>Evasion Rate</LINK>.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃を回避する確率:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The chance to dodge.</C></H></W>

　●It isn't shown as a percentage like the <LINK=0>hit rate</LINK>, but the
　　chance to dodge is called the evasion rate.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>７</W>．命中率を上げるためには？: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>7</W>. How do I raise Hit Rate?
CSB\tＡ．機体の改造、パイロット養成、精神コマンド、強化パーツ、アビリティ効: A. Use unit upgrades, pilot training, Spirit Commands, Parts, Ability Effects.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can do the following.</C></H></W>

　●Upgrade Aim via <LINK=0>Unit Upgrades</LINK>.

　●Raise Accuracy and more via <LINK=1>Pilot Training</LINK>.

　●Use <LINK=2>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as Bullseye.

　●Equip <LINK=3>Parts</LINK> such as a Dual Sensor.

　●Use the <LINK=4>Ability Effect</LINK> Accuracy↑.
CSB\tＡ．機体の改造、パイロット養成、精神コマンド、強化パーツ、アビリティ効: A. Use unit upgrades, pilot training, Spirit Commands, Parts, Ability Effects, terrain.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can do the following.</C></H></W>

　●Upgrade Mobility via <LINK=0>Unit Upgrades</LINK>.

　●Raise Evasion and more via <LINK=1>Pilot Training</LINK>.

　●Use <LINK=2>Spirit Commands</LINK> such as Flash.

　●Equip <LINK=3>Parts</LINK> such as a Servomotor.

　●Use the <LINK=4>Ability Effect</LINK> Evasion↑.

　●Make use of <LINK=5>terrain effects</LINK>.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>９</W>．戦闘で得られるものには何: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>9</W>. What can I earn in combat?
CSB\tＡ．経験値、資金、ＰＰ、強化パーツなどがあります。: A. EXP, funds, PP, Parts and more.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下のものがありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>You can earn the following.</C></H></W>

　●<LINK=0>EXP</LINK> based on level difference.

　●<LINK=1>Funds</LINK>.

　●<LINK=2>PP</LINK>.

　●<LINK=3>Parts</LINK>.
CSB\tＡ．パイロットの格闘と射撃能力の、どちらの影響を受けるかを表します。: A. Whether the pilot's Melee or Ranged stat affects it.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>パイロットの格闘と:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Whether the pilot's Melee or Ranged stat affects it.</C></H></W>

　●In combat, Melee weapons use the pilot's Melee stat and Ranged
　　weapons use the Ranged stat. High-Melee pilots deal more damage
　　with Melee weapons, high-Ranged pilots with Ranged weapons.
CSB\tＡ．その武器を使用して行える、攻撃方法を表します。: A. The attack methods a weapon can use.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>その武器を使用して:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>The attack methods a weapon can use.</C></H></W>

　●The class is shown by the contents of <I=30>. The left side is the
　　main class, the right side the sub class.

　●There are 3 main classes:

　<T=30>[<LINK=0>Normal Attack Weapon</LINK>]</T>
　・Main class is blank (<I=30>).

　<T=30>[<LINK=1>ALL Attack Weapon</LINK>]</T>
　・Main class shows <I=32> (<I=30><S=-79><I=32><S=39>).

　<T=30>[<LINK=2>Map Weapon</LINK>]</T>
　・Main class shows <I=31> (<I=30><S=-81><I=31><S=33>).

　●There are 3 sub classes:

　<T=30>[<LINK=3>Double Attack</LINK>-Capable]</T>
　・Sub class shows <I=33> (<I=30><S=-30><I=33><S=6>).

　<T=30>[<LINK=4>Combination Attack</LINK>-Capable]</T>
　・Sub class shows <I=34> (<I=30><S=-31><I=34><S=7>).

　<T=30>[<LINK=5>Maximum Break</LINK> Support]</T>
　・Sub class shows <I=185> (<I=30><S=-31><I=185><S=7>).

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Separately, weapons showing <I=40> are <LINK=6>Combined Attack</LINK> weapons.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>武器の特徴を表しま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A weapon's traits.</C></H></W>

　<I=37><S=-76><I=36><S=52>
　・Special effects, e.g. status ailments or barrier piercing.

　<I=37><S=-53><I=39><S=29>
　・Usable after the Move command.

　<I=37><S=-30><I=38><S=6>
　・Beam weapons; reduced by barriers like Beam Coat.

　<I=37><S=-30><I=106><S=6>
　・Missile weapons; nullified by Jammer.
CSB\tＡ．武器が攻撃目標のステータス異常を起こす効果を持つかを表します。: A. Whether a weapon inflicts status ailments.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>武器が攻撃目標のス:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Whether a weapon inflicts status ailments.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>[Mobility Down L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's Mobility for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Armor Down L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's Armor for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Movement Down (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's Movement by 4 for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Attack Down L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's final damage for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Range Down (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the max range of all the unit's weapons by 2 for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Aim Down L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's Aim for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[EN Down L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's current EN.

　<T=30>[EN Drain L (R)]</T>
　・Lowers the unit's current EN and adds that amount to the attacker's.

　<T=30>[Stat Down L (P)]</T>
　・Lowers the main pilot's Melee, Ranged, Accuracy, Evasion, Defense
　　and Skill for 1 turn.

　<T=30>[Disable (P)]</T>
　・For 1 turn, blocks all commands except Join, Split, Main and
　　Status, and prevents choosing a response when attacked.

　<T=30>[Will Down L (P)]</T>
　・Lowers the main pilot's Will.

　<T=30>[SP Drain L (P)]</T>
　・Lowers the main pilot's current SP and adds that amount to the
　　attacking unit's main pilot's SP.

　<T=30>[Spirit Seal (P)]</T>
　・Blocks the Spirit command for 1 turn. All ongoing Spirit Commands
　　are also canceled.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>The <LINK=0>Spirit Command</LINK> Belief or Block-type <LINK=1>Special Abilities</LINK>
　　　can prevent status ailments.
CSB\tＡ．武器がバリア系特殊能力を無効化する効果を持つかを表します。: A. Whether a weapon negates barrier abilities.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>武器がバリア系特殊:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Whether a weapon negates barrier abilities.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>[Barrier Negate]</T>
　・Stops the target's barrier abilities from activating.

　<T=30>[Barrier Pierce]</T>
　・Pierces barriers raised by the target.
CSB\tＡ．通常攻撃、全体攻撃、マップ兵器、ダブルアタック、コンビネーション攻: A. Normal, ALL, Map Weapon, Double Attack, Combination Attack, Maximum Break, etc.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下のような攻撃方:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>There are these attack methods.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>[<LINK=0>Normal Attack</LINK>]</T>
　・Attacks using Normal Attack Weapons.
　・Uses weapons whose <LINK=1>class</LINK> shows <I=30>.

　<T=30>[<LINK=2>ALL Attack</LINK>]</T>
　・Attacks using ALL Attack Weapons.
　・Uses weapons whose class shows <I=30><S=-79><I=32><S=39>.

　<T=30>[<LINK=3>Map Weapon</LINK>]</T>
　・Damages every squad in the area of effect.
　・Uses weapons whose class shows <I=30><S=-81><I=31><S=33>.

　<T=30>[<LINK=4>Double Attack</LINK>]</T>
　・Hits the target and a squad adjacent to it.
　・Uses weapons whose class shows <I=30><S=-30><I=33><S=6>.

　<T=30>[<LINK=5>Combination Attack</LINK>]</T>
　・Hits the target and the squads lined up with it.
　・Uses weapons whose class shows <I=30><S=-31><I=34><S=7>.

　<T=30>[<LINK=6>Maximum Break</LINK>]</T>
　・Performed by 2 adjacent Twin Units.
　・Requires a support weapon whose class shows <I=30><S=-31><I=185><S=7>.
CSB\tＡ．攻撃目標の１機にダメージを与える武器です。: A. Weapons that damage 1 target unit.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃目標の１機にダ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Weapons that damage 1 target unit.</C></H></W>

　●Mainly used in <LINK=0>Normal Attacks</LINK>. These weapons <I=30> damage
　　1 unit in the target squad.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>通常攻撃武器を使用:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Attacks using Normal weapons.</C></H></W>

　●Normal Attacks use <LINK=0>Normal Attack Weapons</LINK><I=30> and come in 2
　　forms: Focused and Split.

　<T=30>[Focused Attack]</T>
　・Concentrates the attack on 1 unit in the target squad.

　<T=30>[Split Attack]</T>
　・The 2 units of the attacking <LINK=1>Twin Unit</LINK> each hit a different target.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>If the attacker isn't a <LINK=1>Twin Unit</LINK>, it makes a Focused Attack.

　●Normal Attacks allow <LINK=2>Support Attack</LINK> (Attack Again) and
